message: We agree. Rename uses pi `set_session_name`. For a chat that is not current, the UI first does `switch_session` and awaits it, then renames, then refreshes the list. This runs only when pi is idle. I will fix `agent.rs::read_chat` so that a `session_info` after `CHAT_HEAD` shows: it reads the tail of the file and uses the last `session_info`. I will also change the 'Too late' test at agent.rs:896 to match. There is no `chat_titles` overlay. I accept the final plan below with opus as implementer.
plan: Map (findings 2, 3, 5, 6, 7). In `src/mapLayout.ts`, a `denied:<host>` node gets `active` when it has a blocked event less than ACTIVE_MS old. In `src/ShieldMap.tsx`, a `MapControls` child in a `Panel` uses `useReactFlow()` (zoomIn, zoomOut, fitView) with a motiv `IconButtonGroup`, and `<Controls>` is removed. The `setNodes` effect merges by id. It keeps the current node object (with `measured` and `dragging`) and makes a new object only when `position` or a compared data field changed (label, tone, badges, active, title). `onNodeDragStop` saves `{...layout, ...dragged}` and does not prune. A separate effect prunes, but only after the inputs have loaded. `ShieldPage` passes `folders` as undefined until `listFolders` returns for this shield, and the effect skips `folder:*` ids while `folders` is undefined. ShieldMap registers its own `onDragDropEvent` listener. It hit-tests the drop point against the boundary node rect with `screenToFlowPosition`, the node position and the `measured` size, then calls `onDropFolder(path)`. The `App.tsx` listener handles only `data-drop="rail"`. Each listener acts only on drops inside its own element. Symlink (finding 4). A new Rust command `resolve_folder(path) -> String` wraps `shield::host_dir` (`commands.rs`, `lib.rs`, `api.ts`), with a Rust test. Both drop paths call it before the confirm step. The confirms in `SettingsTab.tsx` and `ShieldRail.tsx` show the canonical path, plus 'link to <target>' when it differs. The guest path comes from the canonical basename. App terminal (finding 8). `Manager::attach_app` returns a `u64` token that is stored with the sink. `detach_app(session_id, token)` clears the sink only when the token matches. `TerminalPane.tsx` ignores output after dispose, detaches in cleanup, and detaches at once if it is disposed while `attachApp` is pending. Draft (finding 9). `ShieldPage.tsx` keeps the ElasticTabs block mounted with `hidden` during chat, terminal and app views, and keeps the last tab in state. It calls fitView again when the map becomes visible. Row actions (finding 1). `ShieldRail.tsx` gets one motiv `IconButton` (Ellipsis) per item. Right-click and Shift+F10 or ContextMenu on the focused treeitem open the same menu, which is made of a motiv Card and ghost Buttons. The menu has focus management, closes on Escape and outside click, and does not conflict with the tree or dnd-kit keys. Apps: Edit (intent `app` with `appId`, which opens an edit draft in AppsSection), Restart (`restartApp`), and Delete (`removeApp`, with confirm). Terminals: Close. Chats: Rename and Delete. Rename uses pi `set_session_name`. If the chat is not current, the UI first awaits `switch_session`, then renames, then refreshes the list. This is permitted only when pi is idle, and it starts the VM if necessary. `agent.rs::read_chat` also scans the tail of the file for the last `session_info`, and the agent.rs:896 test is updated. Chat delete is a new `agent::delete_chat`. It accepts only ids that `list_chats` accepts. It opens `sessions` with NOFOLLOW|DIRECTORY, uses `statat(AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW)` to check for a regular file, and then calls `unlinkat`. If the chat is current, the UI first sends `new_session`. App.tsx records the current chat of each shield from AgentsTab `onChat`. Rust tests cover delete_chat (it refuses links, directories, bad names and a linked sessions dir), late `session_info` titles, resolve_folder, and attach/detach tokens (a stale detach keeps the new sink). Run the three gates in task.md.
